verdict.rationale: Otter's own marketing says key deal details, notes, and next steps are automatically extracted and synced to your CRM, and its pricing page lists Salesforce and HubSpot integrations (marked with an asterisk). Beyond that the evidence is thin: one marketing line, and the other CRM material describes querying the CRM through AI Chat, which is read-side rather than writing notes to it. missing for 10: documentation of how summaries are matched and attached to the correct contact and deal records, any Attio support, detail on the asterisked Salesforce/HubSpot plan caveats, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the sync works.

support.subject: As a sales lead, meeting notes and summaries sync automatically onto the right contact and deal records in my CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio)

citations.quote: Key deal details, notes, and next steps automatically extracted from every meeting and synced to your CRM.
